# Skins 3: the remake (v1.19, contracts for the parallel builders)

The user playtested skins 2 and asked for a full remake: **15 new skins replacing all 21 lines of skins 2**. v1.19 is
not released, so no player loses anything. Everything else in skins 2 (`skins2-contracts.md`) still holds unless this
document says otherwise: the SkinLine/SkinLevel/SkinVariant model, SkinState, item ids, the progression link,
the settings toggles and the picker structure.

**Concept art** (the look target for every line; generated by the user with Higgsfield, used as reference only, never
shipped): `C:\Users\IdoRaz\Desktop\ValTrainer-support\higgsfield\concepts-v1\` (`apex-*.png`, `sig-*.png`). The
in-game version is a procedural shader on low-poly models with no UVs, so match colours, materials, pattern, glow and
motion rather than every detail.

and UI. `Edition` becomes `{ Core, Signature, Apex }`.

| Core | desertcamo | Desert Camo | sand/tan blot camo | n/a |
| Core | anodized | Anodized Teal | brushed teal anodised alloy | n/a |

| Core | twotone | Two-Tone Polymer | dark polymer, light furniture | n/a |
| Signature | glasswork | Glasswork | stained-glass panels in lead came, jewel tones, refracted light | glass chimes, tinkles, shatter |

Avoid look-alikes and sound-alikes of VALORANT lines: no dragons, no ghost bells, no glitch/arcade, no underwater, and
no melodic synth ladders.

## 2. Levels and features (catalogue = Skins data/UI agent)

Every effect recipe id is **the line id** (`Sounds`, `BulletFx`, `KillFx`, `Inspect`, `ReloadAnim`, `Finisher`,
`Banner`).

- **Core**: 1 level, `SkinFeature.None`, no variants. Free from the start.
- **Signature**: 1 level that has everything except animation, finisher and the special reload:
  `Sounds | KillSounds | HitSounds | BulletFx | KillFx | Inspect | KillBanner`. No variants. It is unlocked by progression
  (whole line at once).
- **Apex**: 5 levels and 3 variants (`SkinLooks.Variants`), unlocked level by level:
  1. Base: static look.
  2. Animated: `Animated | Reactive` (look transform from `SkinLooks`/visuals: Anim + React).
  3. Sounds + effects: `Sounds | KillSounds | HitSounds | BulletFx | KillFx`.
  4. Inspect + reload: `Inspect | ReloadAnim | KillBanner`.
  5. Finisher: `Finisher | KillCounter`.

New flags (already in `SkinModel.cs`): `BulletFx` (implies tracers), `Inspect`, `ReloadAnim`, `HitSounds`. New SkinLevel
fields: `BulletFx`, `Inspect`, `ReloadAnim`; SkinState accessors of the same names. The old `Tracers` and
`EquipFlourish` flags stay defined but no new line uses them. An equip flourish may be part of the Inspect recipe.

**Looks** come only from `src/Game/Skins/SkinLooks.cs` (owned by Visuals): `SkinLooks.Look(id)`, `Palette(id)`,
`Variants(id)`, `BaseName(id)`, and the id arrays `Core`, `Signature`, `Apex`. The catalogue writes
`SkinLooks.Look(id) with { Name = L.N(...), Blurb = L.N(...) }`. The level-2 Apex look transform also belongs to
Visuals: `SkinLooks.Animated(id)` (`Func<GunSkin, GunSkin>`). Visuals adds it, and the catalogue uses it after the merge;
until then the catalogue writes `s => s with { Anim = 0.3f, React = 1f }`.

## 3. Finisher rule (Bullet/Kill FX agent): exactly VALORANT's

A finisher plays **only** on the player's kill that eliminates the last living enemy **and** wins the round (the mode
emits `round_won` within `KillTracker.FinisherWindow`). It applies in round modes: Retake and the other tactical modes,
the map drills, duels, defense and agent drills (anything that emits `round_won`).

- No finisher in Deathmatch, rep drills, target drills or measuring tools.
- No "lite" finishers at all: remove the 5-in-a-life rule, MatchWon, and a round won while enemies still live.
- The dev flag `--skinfx-finisher` stays.
- The picker preview may still show the finisher on demand.

## 4. Cross-agent APIs (stubs in base; owners implement; keep the signatures)

- `Viewmodel.Inspect()` and `Viewmodel.Inspecting` (Animation).
  - Inspect works for every gun (factory included). Default key **Y**, rebindable.
  - Fire, ADS, reload, switching or sprinting cancels it.
  - Not available in Sens Finder or Crosshair Finder.
- `SkinAudio.PlayInspect(state, gun)`, `PlayReloadAnim(state, gun, duration)`, `PlayHit(state, headshot, kill)` (Audio).
- Bullet FX entry points (Bullet/Kill FX) are wherever tracers, muzzle flashes and impacts are spawned today. Find them
  and route them through a `BulletFx` recipe when `SkinState.BulletFx != null`.

## 6. Rules for every builder

- Assets are self-made or CC0 only, with no Riot assets, names or look-alikes. AI-made (Higgsfield) assets must NOT ship.
- New UI strings go through `L.T`/`L.N`/`L.F`. Do not edit `translations/*.json`; the integrator regenerates them.
- Preserve each file's line endings and BOM. Don't commit.
- Memory is limited: one Godot instance at a time.
- Dev runs:
  - Always `--dev`, a TEMP COPY of the data dir via `--data-dir`, and an empty or fake `--valorant-dir`.
  - Never write the user's real data.
  - Only capture or kill processes you launched yourself; never touch a running ValTrainer.exe.
- Before any selftest, run `dotnet build` and `godot --headless --path <your copy> --import`.
- Report what you changed (files), any hooks in files you don't own, test results, and the screenshot/preview paths.
